change: Use one authoritative private AtomicU64 for work; ordinary checked additions avoid the observations mutex. Preserve exact per-call publication, zero additions and observation hooks.
proof: Work is monotonic. CAS publishes only checked nonoverflowing additions. Overflow takes the observations mutex before storing MAX and setting the sticky flag. Snapshot retains that mutex while loading work and cloning other fields, so saturation cannot appear without its overflow flag; exact addition to MAX does not falsely set it.
